description_en: Queries task information such as task status and filtering policies for a video purge or prefetch task
description_zh: 调用本接口查询视频刷新或预热任务的任务状态、筛选策略等任务信息
name: GetMediaRefreshJobs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the audio or video purge or prefetch task. This is the value of MediaRefreshJobId returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 音/视频刷新或预热的任务ID，为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html接口返回参数MediaRefreshJobId的值
parameters.name: media_refresh_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The audio or video ID, which is the `MediaIds` value specified when calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html operation. Only one audio or video ID can be specified.

If this parameter is not specified, task information for all audio or video files under the specified `MediaRefreshJobId` is returned. If this parameter is specified, only the task information for the specified audio or video ID under the `MediaRefreshJobId` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID，为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html时传入的`MediaIds`，只能设置一个音/视频ID。

若不传入本参数，则查询`MediaRefreshJobId`下所有音/视频的任务信息；若传入本参数，则只查询`MediaRefreshJobId`下该音/视频ID所对应的任务信息
parameters.name: media_id
